decisions.statement: The substrate has no game.
The substrate has no controller.
The substrate has no policy.
Each thing the rig must do has a silent failure that looks like success.
A frame a software rasterizer drew is pixel-identical to a frame the card drew.
An injector writing to a device nobody reads exits zero.
A screen capture of nothing is still a screen capture.
The X server is Xorg.
Xvfb has no evdev or libinput input backend.
Xvfb takes XTEST alone.
Xvfb can neither open nor consume a device node under /dev/input.
A uinput device is the one input a Windows client cannot tell from hardware.
The dummy video driver gives the framebuffer.
The evdev input driver opens the event node.
The image ships no NVIDIA userspace.
The node injects the whole NVIDIA driver userspace into the container at runtime.
Driver userspace matches the running kernel driver exactly.
A second mismatched userspace on the loader path falls silently back to software.
The image declares the driver capability list this cluster ignores.
GLVND asks the X server for a GLX vendor.
A dummy X server answers Mesa and no other GLX vendor.
The image names the GLX vendor so no GL context lands on llvmpipe.
A driver reading taken on another card is no evidence about the rig's card.
A driver reading taken under another injection mechanism is no evidence here.

definition: the substrate a Windows game client runs on with no display, keyboard or human
